messages:
mia: Kicking off bring-up for crane-7b as a candidate for hosted + dedicated. Need prioritization, canary plan, and fallback strategy. TL;DR: quant experiments done (int8/int4) — int8 looks promising but we saw a small regression on summarization evals. Thoughts?

arjun: Quick numbers: int8 ~2.2x throughput vs fp16, p50 latency +5ms. int4 gives ~3.6x but shows ~6% EM drop on long-context QA. Recommendation: ship int8 first, keep int4 as opt-in.

laura: Agree re: opt-in. For enterprise/dedicated offering we can make int4 available behind an explicit feature gate + SLA note. We need a clear rollout checklist and automated rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: CI: model artifact scan passed. Canary image built: docker.crane/7b:202603. sha:abc123def.

ryan: Proposed canary flow: smoke probes -> 1% prod traffic (1h) -> 5% (3h) -> 20% (24h). Gate checks at each step: latency_p95, error_rate, and a proxy semantic quality metric (squad-f1 on a streaming eval). Fail fast on thresholds.

sofia: Recommend exact quality gates: if avg ROUGE drops >1.5 OR SQuAD F1 drops >3, auto-fail. Also add hallucination probes: run 50 golden prompts; if hallucination score > threshold fail.

mia: Fallback mapping: crane-7b-int8 -> crane-7b-fp16, and a secondary fallback -> crane-3b-safe for severe regressions. Hosted defaults to int8; dedicated can opt into int4 with explicit warning in Console.

laura: Instrumentation checklist: per-request trace id, model_variant tag in logs, store top-k logits for 0.01% sampling, and stream QA logs to long-term storage for 90d. Also wire model_version to observability dashboard.

arjun: Quick rollout policy snippet (for infra):
```json
{
  "policy": "phased",
  "steps": [
    {"name":"smoke","traffic":0.0,"duration":"10m"},
    {"name":"alpha","traffic":0.01,"duration":"1h","checks":["latency_p95<500ms","err_rate<0.5%","eval_squad_f1_drop<3"]},
    {"name":"beta","traffic":0.05,"duration":"3h"},
    {"name":"gamma","traffic":0.2,"duration":"24h"}
  ],
  "fallback":"crane-7b-fp16",
  "rollback_on":"checks_failed"
}
```

mia: Owners: @mia model lead, @arjun perf/quant, @laura infra/telemetry, @sofia quality. Runbook: https://goto/runbooks/crane-7b-bringup

sofia: I'll build the eval harness and golden prompt suite. Plan to run contrastive evals vs crane-3b and raven-6b to check for blind regressions and calibration shifts.

ryan: Ops notes for dedicated: reserve a small GPU pool with burst enabled and pre-warmed KV caches. Warmup script (rough):
```bash
for f in warmup/*.jsonl; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @${f}; sleep 0.1; done
```

laura: Also make canary flaggable per-region; EU customers may require fp16-only fallback until privacy review completes.

mia: Priority lock: 1) hosted int8 stable release, 2) dedicated int4 as opt-in with warnings, 3) consider hosted int4 after extended eval and customer pilots. Scheduling sync Wed 10am to finalize runbook. :thumbsup:
